title.zh: 将打拉省打拉市镇马利加亚村的村立学校由Buenavista-Tete-Ungot初级小学更名为Maligaya初级小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio School in Maligaya, Municipality of Tarlac, Province of Tarlac, from Buenavista-Tete-Ungot Primary School to Maligaya Primary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio School in Maligaya, Municipality of Tarlac, Province of Tarlac, from Buenavista-Tete-Ungot Primary School to Maligaya Primary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Buenavista-Tete-Ungot thành Trường Tiểu học Maligaya
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Buenavista-Tete-Ungot เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Maligaya
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Buenavista-Tete-Ungot menjadi Sekolah Dasar Maligaya
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Buenavista-Tete-Ungot kepada Sekolah Rendah Maligaya

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4783_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio school in Maligaya, Municipality of Tarlac, Province of Tarlac, is hereby changed from Buenavista-Tete-Ungot Primary School to Maligaya Primary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
